title: Coordinate space, scale, and normalization
plainLanguage: Every tracked point starts as a location in the source picture. To compare different videos fairly, the Corpus Pane needs a fixed scale reference, but it must not stretch each frame to force a match.
purpose: Keep raw evidence intact while enabling meaningful cross-source comparisons.

rules.statement: Retain source-pixel coordinates with source top-left origin, X right, Y down.
Keep original coordinates alongside any normalized comparison features. Normalization is a comparison aid, not a rewrite of the source.
Use checked standing display height for whole-body cross-source scale when available; use torso or region scale only for bounded matching when whole-body scale is unavailable.
Never interpret shorter projected limb length as shorter biological anatomy without perspective evidence.

implementation.currentSupport: Fixed calibration and normalized configuration search already exist.
implementation.futureWork: Add explicit normalization method to generated pose signatures.
